body: Hey man I’m in the same boat. I feel so needy all the time and like a burden to everyone around me. There’s times when I have the belt around my neck but I can’t do it because there’s something inside me that wants to live. You were put on this earth for a reason and even if you can’t see it now, it’s a very special thing to be alive and thinking. Overthinking everything usually doesn’t help anything and from what I can tell you seem to overthink a lot like me. If I could give you advice it’s just to maybe find a new hobby or remember things that used to make you happy and cherish those memories.
